IMPORTANT PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY MESSAGE REGARDING PARTICIPATION AT CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
As a result of the COVID-19 emergency, and resulting orders and direction from the President of the United States, the Governor of the State of California, and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health, as well as the City of Palmdale emergency declaration, the public will not be permitted to physically attend the City Council meeting. Councilmembers may choose to participate via conference call.
How to Observe the Meeting:
1) Spectrum local access Channel 27
2) Online live webcast at cityofpalmdale.org.
How to Submit Public Comments through Palmdale eComments on this Agenda:
Note: Public Comments submitted will become part of the official meeting record.
1)Go to the Agendas & Minutes webpage at https://cityofpalmdale.org/310/City-Council-Meetings and find this meeting under Upcoming Events; 2) Click on the eComment button; and 3) Scroll through the agenda to find the agenda item for which you would like to provide a comment and submit your comment.
Please note: The City Council is making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and other applicable laws regulating the conduct of public meetings in order to maximize transparency and public access.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.
1. CALL TO ORDER 5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION MEETINGS.
2. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
3. PUBLIC COMMENTS RECEIVED ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS 4.1 through 4.6.
4. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY/GENERAL COUNSEL of the following item to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding the possible initiation of litigation by the City.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
Initiation of litigation pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision
(d) of Section 54956.9: Number of cases - One.
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case; such disclosure may harm settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation.
4.2 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
Responsible Growth Palmdale, et al. v. City of Palmdale, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court
Case No. 20STCP00484
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.3 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding certain existing facts and circumstances that constitute a significant exposure to litigation against the City. The existing facts and circumstances that constitute a significant exposure to litigation are detailed in the following claims received by the City, which are available for public inspection pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.5:
Claimant: Special District Risk Management Authority
City Claim No.: 2019-071
Date Filed: November 25, 2019
Date of Loss: 2016 - 2018
Claimant: Special District Risk Management Authority
City Claim No.: 2020-19
Date Filed: April 15, 2020
Date of Loss: 2016 - 2019
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of these matters and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss these matters in public.
4.4 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding certain existing facts and circumstances that constitute a significant exposure to litigation against the City. The existing facts and circumstances that constitute a significant exposure to litigation are detailed in the following claim received by the City, which is available for public inspection pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.5:
Claimant: Hromadka & Associates
City Claim No.: 2020-003
Date Filed: January 6, 2020
Date of Loss: None Provided
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.5 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of a Council discussion with the City Attorney and Personnel Manager in connection with possible changes to contract terms and conditions in the existing Employment Agreement between the City and Wm. Matthew Ditzhazy, as City Attorney, including an evaluation of performance.
This closed session is necessary because a public discussion of this item, prior to a complete discussion by the Council of contract and ordinance terms, conditions and options, would be prejudicial to the City.
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54957 and 54957.6.
4.6 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding the possible participation in an amicus brief by a group of California cities in the following named action:
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
Initiation of litigation (joining in an amicus brief) pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision
(d) of Section 54956.9: Number of cases - One.
Joinder in Amicus Brief and Support: Petition for Writ of Certiorari
Don Higginson v. Xavier Bacerra, in his capacity as Attorney General of California, City of Poway, Appeal from US 9th Circuit Court of Appeals
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY/GENERAL COUNSEL of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
